#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
#define pii pair<int,int>
#define mp make_pair
#define inf 100000000
#define nn 6000
namespace mcmf{
	vector<int> v[nn],rev[nn],cost[nn],cap[nn];
	void add_edge(int x,int y,int c,int w)
	{
		rev[x].push_back(v[y].size());rev[y].push_back(v[x].size());
		v[x].push_back(y);v[y].push_back(x);
		cost[x].push_back(w);cost[y].push_back(-w);
		cap[x].push_back(c);cap[y].push_back(0);
	}
	
	int dist[nn];int vis[nn];
	int prex[nn],prei[nn];
	void spfa(int s)
	{
		memset(dist,0x3f,sizeof dist);
		memset(vis,0,sizeof vis);prex[s]=-1;
		queue<int> q;q.push(s);dist[s]=0;vis[s]=1;
		
		while(q.size())
		{
			int x=q.front();q.pop();vis[x]=0;
			for(int i=0;i<v[x].size();i++)
			{
				int y=v[x][i];
				int cc=dist[x]+cost[x][i];
				if(dist[y]>cc and cap[x][i])
				{
					dist[y]=cc;prex[y]=x,prei[y]=i;
					if(!vis[y]) vis[y]=1,q.push(y);
				}
			}
		}
		
	}
	
	int tot=0;
	int dfs(int x,int flow)
	{
		if(prex[x]==-1) return flow;
		int y=x;x=prex[y];int i=prei[y],j=rev[x][i];
		int f=dfs(x,min(flow,cap[x][i]));
		cap[x][i]-=f,cap[y][j]+=f;
		return f;
	}
	
	pii solve(int s,int t)
	{
		int ans=0;tot=0;
		while(1)
		{
			spfa(s);
			if(dist[t]>1e9) break;
			int f=dfs(t,inf);
			tot+=f*dist[t];
			ans+=f;
		}
		return mp(ans,tot);
	}
	
};

int n,m,s=nn-1,t=nn-2;
int k,c,d;
int get(int x,int tim){
	return tim*52-52+x;
}
int main() 
{
	scanf("%d%d%d%d%d",&n,&m,&k,&c,&d);int kk=k;
	while(k--){
		int x;scanf("%d",&x);
		mcmf::add_edge(s,get(x,1),1,0);
	}k=kk;
	while(m--){
		int x,y;scanf("%d%d",&x,&y);
		for(int i=1;i<100;i++)
			for(int j=1;j<=k;j++) mcmf::add_edge(get(x,i),get(y,i+1),1,d*(j+j-1));
		swap(x,y);
		for(int i=1;i<100;i++)
			for(int j=1;j<=k;j++) mcmf::add_edge(get(x,i),get(y,i+1),1,d*(j+j-1));
	}
	for(int i=1;i<100;i++){
		for(int j=1;j<=n;j++) mcmf::add_edge(get(j,i),get(j,i+1),inf,0);
		mcmf::add_edge(get(1,i),t,inf,c*(i-1));
	}
	printf("%d",mcmf::solve(s,t).second);
	return 0;
}
